newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Clabecq sinks further into loss in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Clabecq sinks further into loss in 95/96.

text.p: Operating loss before writeoffs 134.6 vs 780.6 profit

NOTE - Belgian steel producer Forges de Clabecq is awaiting clearance from the European Commission on a 1.5-billion-franc recapitalisation by its main shareholder, Belgium's Walloon region. Clabecq has started a restructuring operation which will involve 700 job losses
A management report to shareholders in which the results were published said it was clear that putting the reorganisation plan in place was a vital condition for survival.

"The continuation of activities also implies continuing to find synergies with other groups and production sites," it added. "We emphasize that the plan's success is also on condition of a positive evolution of prices in our markets."
It said the success of the company's efforts was still not guaranteed.
